answer: At each protocol dawn, enrollment is capped to one bonded ticket per hardware TPM quote. That ticket must climb a spiral lock: 10 units frozen for 1 epoch, 20 more for 2, 40 for 4, earlier tranches left untouched. The packet carries a work fable: a hash-linked log of three paid jobs settled to unconnected counterparties, each receipt countersigned on-ledger. Tickets whose fables collide under simhash distance 12 are treated as one cohort; the whole spiral is burned and that TPM quote is barred for 16 epochs. Mass clones then pay rising time-locked capital and cannot reuse settlement history.
